title: Seat-lock and allotment invariant tests (S2-02)

input.requestedOutcome: Add invariant tests (assertions that fail if the rule is broken) protecting the interlocking seat-lock/allotment rules: children contribute 0 to the pool (bkV2LockPoolHold:41783); month locks use rolling per-trip release not a global expiry (:41696); lockDraws is the source of truth for lock usage, not the used counter; over-capacity pending_approval bookings hold no seats (bkPendHoldsSeat:12040); charter never consumes seats; the hard-block vs soft-confirm split in the anti-overbook guard at :76672; and the cancelled-status exclusion across all six named aggregate sites.
acceptanceCriteria: Real-execution (vm-sandboxed, extracted-from-source) tests for each of the 7 invariant clusters named in the ticket

Add only the delta beyond LAM-77's existing characterization suite (tests/legacy/seat-locks.test.mjs, tests/legacy/cancelled-status-aggregates.test.mjs on origin/main) and state the overlap explicitly
Enumerate and cover all six aggregate sites for the cancelled-status exclusion; report the real count/locations found, not an assumed number
Reuse the LAM-22 test harness pattern (node:test, zero new dependencies) rather than inventing a new one
Read allotment_v2.html only, never edit it
constraints: Do not edit test/helpers/**, test/fixtures/**, or root package.json -- declare needed changes as dependencies instead
Do not touch test/regression/edit-preserve/** (LAM-25, concurrent task)
Do not edit allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html -- read only
Stage only explicitly owned paths (git add -- <path>), never git add -A / git add .
No Postgres or prod service reachable from this sandbox; report DB/prod checks as blocked rather than inventing results
assumptions: test/ (helpers/fixtures/unit/e2e from LAM-22) already exists on this branch and is safe to import from as a read-only dependency
tests/legacy/ (LAM-77) does not exist on this branch -- read via `git show origin/main:tests/legacy/...` without checking it out, per task instructions

The six aggregate sites are the six functions LAM-77 itself names (getSeatsConsumed, getBookingsForRouteDate, baCharterBoatMap, flBoatBookingsFor, baAssignedPax, baAssignedBookings), independently re-verified to exist in this branch's allotment_v2.html at matching line numbers

output.summary: Added 60 real-execution node:test assertions under test/regression/seat-locks/** covering 7 seat-lock/allotment invariant clusters, each run against the actual extracted allotment_v2.html source in a node:vm sandbox: (1) child-lock pool-hold non-double-counting under multiple children, (2) month-lock rolling per-trip release vs the bkV2LockExpireSweep global-expiry companion rule, (3) lockDraws as the source of truth over the lock's used counter (bkV2LockClaims/bkV2LockAudit), (4) bkPendHoldsSeat boundary values in isolation, (5) the anti-overbook guard's exact tier boundaries plus a mixed-tier multi-trip case, (6) all six named cancelled-status aggregate sites executed for real (five newly executed; getSeatsConsumed left to LAM-77 to avoid duplication), and (7) charter-never-consumes-seats via baSeatBookingsForRoute and baDayBoats. Added local lib/source.mjs + lib/sandbox.mjs helpers (same technique as LAM-77's, kept inside this task's owned tree since test/helpers/** is not owned here). No application code changed.

risks: The source-extraction helpers are brittle by construction (grep/brace-scan by exact function name or literal marker text) -- a future rename of one of the ~20 extracted function names, or an edit to the exact literal markers used by extractBetween() in anti-overbook-guard-tiers.test.mjs, will make the corresponding test throw a clear 'not found' error rather than silently pass incorrectly. This is the same trade-off LAM-77 made for the same reason (testing real code, not a paraphrase) and is treated as acceptable, matching precedent.
